limits: This is logical equivalence for the fixed current migration/test scope, not universal PostgreSQL equivalence.
Physical OIDs, relation file identities, planner statistics, MVCC transaction IDs and byte-level page contents are not required to match.
Actual random UUID outputs and server clock values naturally differ; unchanged definitions and runtime are the equivalence condition.
The runtime source is the same per-run verified immutable container environment; no previous-run result is cached or trusted.
The pinned Unicode probe is an extra runtime witness, not a replacement for the complete 382-case first replay.
If schema, source, runtime or first-case replay differs/fails, the audit fails; it does not silently accept reduced coverage.
The stronger fingerprint changes preservation values; fresh suite verification is required. No new database success or timing is claimed.
